about.title: A thoughtful approach to everyday wellbeing.
about.intro: Get to know Nutrimed: the values behind our work, the way we think about nutrition, and the principles that guide our company.
about.storyTitle: We believe the way we work matters as much as what we offer.
about.storyBody: Nutrimed brings together a people-first outlook and a considered approach to nutritional products. We believe trust is earned through clear communication, careful choices, and consistency in the details.
about.storySecond: Our public website is a place to learn about the company and explore the products we make available. As our range and company information grow, this space will continue to reflect the latest approved information.
about.principleOneText: We aim to make decisions with a clear purpose and a focus on the people who rely on the products they choose.
about.principleTwoText: We value honest information, thoughtful communication, and dependable relationships.
about.principleThreeText: We believe quality is reflected in the small decisions made throughout the work.
about.closingTitle: Have a question about our company or product range?

products.intro: Browse the Nutrimed product range. Product information and availability are managed by our team and shown here when published.
products.catalogNote: Product information on this website is provided for general reference. Please contact Nutrimed for current product details and availability.

commitment.title: A standard of care in every part of the work.
commitment.intro: The principles that shape how we think, communicate, and approach the products we make available.
commitment.standardTitle: Care should be consistent, considered, and visible.
commitment.standardBody: We approach our work with attention to quality, respect for people, and a responsibility to communicate clearly. These principles are not a slogan; they are a guide for the decisions we make and the experience we want people to have.
commitment.qualityBody: We place quality at the centre of our thinking and pay attention to the details that shape a dependable product experience.
commitment.peopleBody: We keep individuals, families, and the needs of the communities we serve in mind.
commitment.responsibilityBody: We aim to provide clear, accurate information and avoid promises that product information cannot support.
commitment.careBody: We value consistency and ongoing attention across our work, from product information to customer conversations.
commitment.promiseTitle: Trust is built through what we do consistently.
